hypothesis: The M162 M156 boundary-outcome corpus can support a very small guarded actor-coupling update that improves wrong-history outcome preference without degrading protected behavior.
success_criteria: initialize from the M156 s20 checkpoint
train only a tightly scoped actor coupling or equivalent low-drift actor slice
use baseline or snippet action anchors to prevent broad behavior drift
pass cheap behavior retention against M156 and M142 on zero-relvel obstacle benchmarks
pass protected critical-key replay before any PPO admission
state whether a PPO continuation is admitted
failure_criteria: feed target ids, group ids, relocated geometry keys, hidden parameters, or outcome labels to the deployable actor
accept an actor update based only on objective loss without behavior gates
ignore the M142 calibration failure from M162

commands.name: m163_guarded_actor_coupling_update
commands.command: Run a small actor-coupling update from M156 on the M162 M156 corpus with anchors and retention gates.

decision_rule: Admit PPO only if the small actor update improves the M162 outcome objective while passing behavior retention and protected-key gates; otherwise keep it as a rejected objective-only candidate.
